name: agent-prose
title_zh: 给 Agent 写说明书的人，先过一遍这双眼睛
tagline_zh: 写 AGENTS.md、改 skill 提示词时，它逐句挑刺：含糊指令、缺上下文、变量没定义。你定规矩。
tagline_en: When you write or revise AGENTS.md or skill prompts, it flags vague directives, missing context, and undefined.
desc_en: Write or audit agent-facing instructions: skills, context files like AGENTS.md, and what they point to. Use when creating or changing one, when the user names one to review, or to record their standing conventions. Not for end-user prose, code design, or running a skill.
why_zh: 它审的是「给机器看的文字」：不评风格，只查可执行性。能把你的口头约定固化成可复用的审查标准。
why_en: It reviews machine-facing prose for executability, not style. It turns your ad-hoc conventions into a reusable checklist that.
limit_zh: 不碰面向人类的文案、不评代码架构、不替你运行 skill。只认 agent 指令类文本；你给它看散文或代码。
limit_en: Not for human-facing copy, code design, or running skills. Only audits agent-directed text; feed it prose or code and it stops and says out of scope.
title_en: An editor that audits instructions written for AI agents
